name: Computer Science & Engineering
description: Software engineering, systems, data and AI, taught with industry tools and real projects.
vision: To advance the intellectual capacity of the nation and the international community by imparting knowledge to graduates who are globally recognized as innovators, entrepreneur and competent professionals.
mission: To provide excellent technical knowledge and computing skills to make the graduates globally competitive with professional ethics.
To involve in research activities and be committed to lifelong learning to make positive contributions to the society.

name: Information Science & Engineering
description: Information systems, cloud computing, data engineering and web technologies.
vision: To train skilled and ethical professionals with an ability to plan, design, develop, organize and manage modern and traditional information systems with the knowledge of Information technologies, services and organizations globally.
mission: To impart high quality engineering education in the field of Information Science & Technology with strong theoretical and extensive practical training methodologies through innovation and research to make world class engineers.

name: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
description: Machine learning, deep learning, language models and responsible AI.
vision: To prepare students to serve society with a holistic approach and participate in nation building.
mission: To lay a strong foundation in theoretical concepts and experimental learning in the field of artificial intelligence and machine learning, and allied fields. To inculcate self-learning abilities, team spirit, and professional ethics among the students to emerge as valued entrepreneurs and serve society.
To promote innovation and entrepreneurship ideas among students to be job creators in the future.
history: 2021–22: Department established with an intake of 60
peos: PEO1: Graduates will possess fundamental knowledge of engineering and will pursue successful careers as software professionals, AI developers, data analysts and data scientists.
PEO2: Graduates will demonstrate lifelong learning in the field of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.
PEO3: Graduates will perform their duties with professional skills and ethics.
psos: PSO1: Design thinking and problem solving: understand, formulate and solve interdisciplinary problems with AI tools.
PSO2: Professional skill: apply appropriate AI and ML techniques and contribute to society through innovation, research and entrepreneurship.
pos: PO1: Engineering knowledge: Apply the knowledge of mathematics, science, engineering fundamentals and an engineering specialization to the solution of complex engineering problems.

PO2: Problem analysis: Identify, formulate, review research literature and analyse complex engineering problems, reaching substantiated conclusions using first principles of mathematics, natural sciences and engineering sciences.

PO3: Design and development of solutions: Design solutions for complex engineering problems and design system components or processes that meet the specified needs with appropriate consideration for public health and safety, and cultural, societal and environmental considerations.

PO4: Conduct investigations of complex problems: Use research-based knowledge and research methods, including design of experiments, analysis and interpretation of data, and synthesis of the information to provide valid conclusions.

PO5: Modern tool usage: Create, select and apply appropriate techniques, resources and modern engineering and IT tools, including prediction and modelling, to complex engineering activities with an understanding of their limitations.

PO6: The engineer and society: Apply reasoning informed by contextual knowledge to assess societal, health, safety, legal and cultural issues and the consequent responsibilities relevant to professional engineering practice.

PO7: Environment and sustainability: Understand the impact of professional engineering solutions in societal and environmental contexts, and demonstrate the knowledge of, and need for, sustainable development.
PO8: Ethics: Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics and the responsibilities and norms of engineering practice.
PO9: Individual and team work: Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse teams and in multidisciplinary settings.

PO10: Communication: Communicate effectively on complex engineering activities with the engineering community and with society at large, such as being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations, and give and receive clear instructions.

PO11: Project management and finance: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of engineering and management principles and apply these to one's own work, as a member and leader in a team, to manage projects in multidisciplinary environments.
PO12: Life-long learning: Recognise the need for, and have the preparation and ability to engage in, independent and life-long learning in the broadest context of technological change.
curriculum: Semester 1 (2025 scheme): Applied Mathematics-I; Applied Chemistry; Introduction to AI and Applications; Engineering Science Course-I; Programming Language Course; Communication Skills; Indian Constitution and Engineering Ethics; Innovation and Design Thinking Lab

Semester 2 (2025 scheme): Applied Mathematics-I; Applied Physics; Computer-Aided Engineering Drawing; Engineering Science Course-I; Programme Specific Course; Soft Skills; Programme Specific Course Lab; Innovation and Design Thinking Lab; Samskrutika Kannada / Balake Kannada

Semester 3 (2025 scheme): Mathematics for Computer Science; Digital Design and Computer Organization; Operating Systems; Data Structures and Applications; Data Structures Lab; Social Connect and Responsibility; Ability or Skill Enhancement Course III

Semester 4 (2025 scheme): Analysis and Design of Algorithms; Artificial Intelligence; Database Management Systems; Analysis and Design of Algorithms Lab; Ability or Skill Enhancement Course IV; Biology for Engineers; Universal Human Values

Semester 5 (2022 scheme): Software Engineering and Project Management; Computer Networks; Theory of Computation; Data Visualization Lab; Professional Elective; Mini Project; Research Methodology and IPR; Environmental Studies
Semester 6 (2022 scheme): Big Data Analytics; Machine Learning; Machine Learning Lab; Professional Elective; Open Elective; Project Phase I; Ability Enhancement or Skill Development Course V
Semester 7 (2022 scheme): Deep Learning and Reinforcement Learning; Machine Learning II; Data Security and Privacy; Professional Elective; Open Elective; Major Project Phase II
Semester 8 (2022 scheme): Professional Elective (online, through NPTEL, Coursera or Springboard); Open Elective (online); Internship in industry or research (14 to 20 weeks)
employment_scope: Corporate jobs: Industry careers in IT, AI and ML, data science, software development, cybersecurity and emerging technologies.
Government jobs: Preparation for the civil services, PSUs, banking, defence and other government-sector opportunities.
Higher studies: Preparation for GATE, UGC-NET, CAT, MAT and other competitive examinations for advanced education and research.
Entrepreneurship and startups: Support for innovation, startup development, business creation and self-employment.
Research and innovation: Opportunities in R&D centres, research laboratories, product development and technological innovation.
Global careers and certifications: International careers through specialised skills, professional certifications and industry-recognised qualifications.
achievements: A student of the department secured 8th rank at VTU with a CGPA of 9.48.

name: Mechanical Engineering
description: Design, manufacturing, thermal engineering and robotics.
vision:
To nurture creativity and critical thinking in applying engineering skills to analyze and face the fast growing globalization.
To develop holistic personality of the learners and to create professionally superior and ethically strong global manpower.
To create center of excellence in research and development.
mission: The mission of the department is to transform students into world class mechanical engineers by providing a high quality engineering education through effective teaching learning process and creation of new knowledge so as to make them highly professional.
To offer a well-balanced programme of instruction, practical experience, and opportunities for overall personality development.
To shape the students as disciplined humane engineers who can build a strong, peaceful and dynamic country.

name: Electronics & Communication Engineering
description: VLSI, embedded systems, signal processing and communication networks.
vision: To shape the students as disciplined human engineers who can build a strong, peaceful and vibrant country and focus on mutual respect, tolerance and professional ethics.
mission: M1: To provide the best possible educational experience.
M2: Excellence in teaching and research activities for today's students and professionals of tomorrow.
M3: To hone young minds and train them to be conscientious individuals.
M4: Will serve the society as competent professionals in the field of Electronics and Communication Engineering.
research_areas: Internet of Things and wireless communication

name: Mathematics
description: Engineering mathematics, statistics and the foundations for AI and quantum computing.
vision: To build the mathematical thinking every engineer needs to model, analyse and solve real problems.
mission: Teach engineering mathematics with clarity and real-world applications.
Support AI, data science and quantum computing with strong foundations in linear algebra, probability and statistics.
Encourage research in pure and applied mathematics.
Mentor students who need additional support.

name: Physics
description: Engineering physics, materials and the quantum mechanics behind quantum computing.
vision: To inspire curiosity about the physical world and give engineers the scientific foundation for emerging technologies, including quantum.
mission: Teach engineering physics through experiments and demonstrations.
Introduce quantum mechanics as the foundation for quantum computing and sensing.
Promote research in materials, photonics and applied physics.
Develop scientific temper and careful measurement habits.

name: Chemistry
description: Engineering chemistry for materials, energy and the environment.
vision: To give engineers a strong foundation in chemistry for sustainable materials, energy and the environment.
mission: Teach engineering chemistry with a focus on materials, energy and the environment.
Train students in safe and accurate laboratory practice.
Promote research in green chemistry, corrosion and energy storage.
Raise awareness of sustainability and environmental responsibility.

name: Humanities
description: Communication, professional ethics, Universal Human Values and the Constitution of India.
vision: To develop engineers who communicate clearly, think critically and act with integrity.
mission: Build professional communication, writing and presentation skills.
Teach Universal Human Values, professional ethics and the Constitution of India.
Strengthen language, soft skills and career readiness.
Encourage social awareness and responsible citizenship.

name: Physical Education and Sports
description: Indoor and outdoor sports, fitness and inter-college competitions.
vision: To promote fitness, teamwork and sporting excellence as part of every student's education.
mission: Provide coaching for indoor and outdoor sports.
Encourage participation in university, state and national competitions.
Promote health, fitness and wellbeing for students and staff.
Build leadership, discipline and team spirit through sport.
